objective: Model-free bounded executable mechanism PROGRAM SYNTHESIS from independently archived original-negative-driven F126 decision. Discover least-complex graph query program in typed grammar using TRAIN only; execute a compiled AST in source-only graph challenge. This is NOT AI-generated arbitrary source-code, learned neural mechanism or independent scientific acceptance.

grammar.compiled_rules: For each role in fixed public 3-hop role sequence, construct a partial environment of subject/object bindings using only graph edges. When join flag false, intermediate variables may be unconstrained. When start/end anchors false do not require their original query endpoints. No access to truth, case seed, counterfactual labels inside candidate evaluator. Compile every 3-bit AST combination. Candidate is a deterministic runtime-interpreted program, not a new source-code patch.
grammar.candidate_rank: Train-only balanced pair accuracy descending, then number of enabled constraints ascending, then stable AST digest; do not use confirmation for selection.

evaluation.source: F126 authenticated selected problem, then new F127 counterfactual hash-key graph generator. Positive and negative graph topology and role multiset controlled. Exactly one grounded start->end joined chain on positive; none on negative. Add false full path beginning at right start but ending wrong target, false full path ending right target but starting wrong source, and source-unreachable full path to disambiguate missing anchors; preserve role marginals.

benchmarks.strong_exact_connected_graph_solver: Hardcoded upper bound, never evaluator feature or policy input
benchmarks.criterion: A generated AST must be train-selected, 64/64 full heldout paired correct and no different AST with lower complexity has same train score. Stronger exact oracle is 64/64; no claim greater than symbolic.

automation.future_scheduled_policy: On future schedule, require genuinely previous F126 successful scheduled-main artifacts; fail closed rather than masquerade pinned PR archive. Do not add any new schedule, repository writer or external service.
